answer: Bind each account to a fresh server-issued nonce, then require a randomly selected independent quorum to verify useful work before its bond vests. The quartz ledger anchors a receipt that cannot be reused across identities; a vine of independent reviewers blocks self-attestation, and a gale of cloned joins is capped by per-epoch quotas. A farm must lock separate capital and supply separate verified work for every head, paying that cost continuously.
